_doc: tools/depth_check.py's classification of every non-tail recursion on the host-called closure (lane serve-depth, PKT-877). bounded: the depth has a bound that is not an article count, a group's articles, a history, a queue or an octet count, named. debt: such a walk, not yet a loop; the list only shrinks (make it a loop twin and delete the entry). bounded names its bound (a *constant* the tree defines, a number, or a structural bound: decimal digits, a fixed width or shape, car-nesting); operator data -- a configuration table, a profile field, an operator-set count -- is not a bound under D27 and is debt (lane peer-list-depth moved 116 such entries, prefixed 'D27: ').

bounded.fn-anchor-le-bytes: walks k, always called with literal 4 or 8 (uint32/uint64 LE encode width), never store data
bounded.fn-anchor-wire-add-final-end: walks offsets, capped at *fn-anchor-wire-max-tags*=32 (checked in fn-anchor-wire-parse-message)
bounded.fn-anchor-wire-le-value: walks octets of one fixed-width LE field (4 or 8 octets via le32/le64), never a whole message
bounded.fn-anchor-wire-split: n is 4 (fixed LE-field width) or an offset gap; message capped at *fn-anchor-wire-max-response*=4096 by the caller
bounded.fn-anchor-wire-zeroes: walks count = *fn-anchor-wire-request-padding-octets* = 976, a fixed protocol constant
bounded.fn-article-ascii-downcase: walks bytes of one header name/line, capped at *fn-article-max-line-octets*=998
bounded.fn-authsec-octets: x is always a small credential/identity field (16-octet salt, an AUTHINFO secret, a digest, a label), never store content
bounded.fn-b3-node: BLAKE3's chunk tree (books/blake3.lisp): each call splits the input at the largest power-of-two chunk count, so the depth is log2 of the input's chunks (<= 64)
bounded.fn-b3x-node: the same BLAKE3 chunk tree over the stobj (books/blake3-stobj.lisp): depth log2 of the input's chunks (<= 64)
bounded.fn-bp-eid-before-dot: cs is an EID's characters, bounded by the EID text limit *fn-bpc-max-text*=1024
bounded.fn-bpa-encode-fields: fields is a fixed-shape ADU record, always *fn-bpa-field-count*=9 fields
bounded.fn-bpa-read-fields: count is always the literal *fn-bpa-field-count*=9 (fixed ADU record shape)
bounded.fn-bpb-block-numbers: xs is one bundle's block list, capped at *fn-bpb-max-blocks*=32
bounded.fn-bpb-decode-blocks: budget is capped at *fn-bpb-max-blocks*+1=33 by its caller (books/bp-bundle.lisp)
bounded.fn-bpb-encode-blocks: xs is one bundle's block list, capped at *fn-bpb-max-blocks*=32
bounded.fn-bpb-front: xs is one bundle's block list, capped at *fn-bpb-max-blocks*=32
bounded.fn-bpc-dec: walks budget, called with *fn-bpc-max-items*=128 (books/bp-primary-cbor.lisp:876), a small fixed constant
bounded.fn-bpc-enc: walks x, a primary-block value tree; its decode counterpart is capped at *fn-bpc-max-items*=128, a small constant
bounded.fn-bpcd-first: n is always the literal *fn-bpcd-boot-width*=36 (a fixed boot-id string width)
bounded.fn-bpfw-sort: merge sort: each call halves the list (fn-bpfw-evens), so the depth is log n of the fragment count
bounded.fn-bpn-report-read-status: n is always called as the literal 4 (fn-bpn-report-read-status-report), the fixed RFC 9171 assertion count
bounded.fn-bpn-report-status-octets: walks xs, a bundle status report's assertion list; always exactly 4 (RFC 9171's fixed assertions)
bounded.fn-bpnf-immutable-blocks: walks blocks, one bundle's block list, capped at *fn-bpb-max-blocks*=32
bounded.fn-bpnp-forward-blocks: blocks is one bundle's block list, capped at *fn-bpb-max-blocks*=32

bounded.fn-bpp-name-delim-at: walks xs, capped at *fn-bpc-max-text*=1024 by its caller fn-bpp-dtn-sspp's length check before the call

bounded.fn-col-poll-index-window: budget is capped at *fn-col-poll-max-scan*=16, a fixed small constant (the consumer poll's own bound)

bounded.fn-ncfg-show-digits-rev: Walks n via floor-by-10; a number's decimal digits (log n).

bounded.fn-ncr-json-members: walks pairs, one CLI report's small fixed field set (kind, Message-ID, reason)
bounded.fn-nctrl-admin-words-decode: Walks count; caller fn-nctrl-admin-argv-decode checks count <= *fn-native-admin-max-arguments* = 16 first.

bounded.fn-nls-names: Walks names, staging-orphan filenames; the host's sweep stops at a fixed observation bound.
bounded.fn-nls-profile-words: Walks report, the store profile's fixed field list (a record's fixed field list).
bounded.fn-nntp-upcase-keyword: walks a command keyword token; bounded by the 510-octet command line
bounded.fn-nop-marker-octets: Walks names; the only caller passes the fixed 5-item *fn-nop-store-markers* list.
bounded.fn-nov-fmt-octet-lines: walks a fixed constant list (7 or 3 items: OVERVIEW.FMT/HEADERS), never traffic
bounded.fn-ns-append: walks 'a'; only fixed HMAC pad blocks (64 octets) or short magic/length fields

bounded.fn-oct-word-octets: k is a small fixed word width encoding a numeric field

bounded.fn-pinv-lines: walks a peering-invitation document; a small fixed protocol format
